answer: At the port, nothing leaves the yard without a stamp on the manifest, and the manifest is copied to the customs house the same day. Proof of customs broker licence via national customs authority register is that kind of paper trail: a register the customs authority has updated at every port inspection. Clearing one container on a forged stamp takes a bribe; clearing a thousand takes a thousand stamps, a thousand trucks, and the basalt of every driver logged at the gate — the pearl is the gate log, the willow the stamp pad the harbour office locks away each night.
